component.name: hackterm
component.summary: Look like you're breaching a mainframe

description.p: hackterm is a cinematic fake-hacking console for your terminal. Type anything and fluent exploit code pours out, while a globe, a radar, a hex dump and a password cracker run around it. It's pure theatre: it makes no network connections and runs no commands.

ul.li: Type anything and convincing code appears
ACCESS GRANTED, INTRUSION ALERT, trace and download popups on a key
Four map panels: globe, network map, radar and traceroute
Matrix rain, glitches and a corner of the screen that melts
A screensaver mode that is safe for OLED screens

description.p: hackterm runs in a terminal window.

screenshot.caption: The main screen: map, memory dump, terminal, password cracker and systems

description.p: The Saver: hackterm can now be your screensaver. --screensaver runs by itself, quits on any key and is safe for OLED screens. --screensavepreview shows everything it does in about a minute.
Smaller standalone binaries, and a Homebrew tap.
F10 melts a corner of the screen, and packages for every major distro.
